mainEntity.name: What role do customer reviews play in Service Area Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer reviews are critical to effective Service Area Optimization. Positive reviews on Google My Business and other local platforms not only build trust and credibility with potential customers but also significantly influence your local search rankings. Businesses with a higher quantity of positive reviews and a good average star rating tend to rank higher in local search results and the Google Maps Pack. Responding to all reviews, positive and negative, further demonstrates engagement and enhances your local SEO efforts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Customer reviews are crucial; positive feedback and responses build trust, improve local search rankings, and increase visibility on platforms like Google My Business.
